lumina.notes: Locked across all episode scenes. Do not substitute with vials or bottles unless explicitly scripted.

miller_sanctuary_farm_exterior.desc: Upgraded sanctuary farm at flat valley-floor ground level in a sunlit emerald alpine valley featuring a warm oak-and-white-stone farmhouse with clear quartz glass windows, white-stone water channels, natural grass yard, and purple lavender rows.

old_miller_cottage_interior.desc: Warm timber-and-stone cottage interior with rough-hewn oak beams, stone hearth, oak dining table, and wide clear quartz glass windows.
